theater_san_quest_01_03_17:
...Wh-what is this?!
This naughty, pink, filthy book?!
theater_san_quest_01_03_18:
Huh...? Now that I look closely...
all these books are...erotic prints?!
theater_san_quest_01_03_19:
Shunga: Racy illustrated books that circulated
in the Far East long, long ago.
theater_san_quest_01_03_20:
Eeek! They're not mine!
They were just dumped around here...
theater_san_quest_01_03_21:
Now that I think about it...
I heard about this from a customer
at the food stand.
theater_san_quest_01_03_22:
In Orario's back alleys, there's a place where
lust-lost youths dump these books—not a
sanctuary, but a SINctuary.
theater_san_quest_01_03_23:
Th-then... Lady Haruhime has been sneaking
out of the manor every night...
to look at these prints...?
theater_san_quest_01_03_24:
Ah, ah, ah...!
It's not untrue, but... It's not like that!
theater_san_quest_01_03_25:
It's just curiosity...or a burning thirst for
knowledge... Um, um...! How do I put it...
theater_san_quest_01_03_26:
Sneaking around with stuff like this...
What are you, a teenage boy?!
theater_san_quest_01_03_27:
Banned, banned! You're banned from ever
coming here again!
theater_san_quest_02_01_01:
Wh...why...
How did it...come to this...
theater_san_quest_02_01_03:
Oh... What's all this?
These pitch-black...unidentifiable objects?
theater_san_quest_02_01_04:
I...tried to make Far Eastern tempura for
everyone, but before I knew it, this disaster...
theater_san_quest_02_01_05:
I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry...!
I've wasted such precious ingredients!!
theater_san_quest_02_01_06:
Ah... I see. Tempura.
It's a hard dish, with the oil temperature
and everything.
theater_san_quest_02_01_07:
They say tempura chefs in the Far East
take decades to master their craft.
theater_san_quest_02_01_08:
I feel the weight of that keenly...
Perhaps a clumsy girl like me should
never have tried.
theater_san_quest_02_01_09:
Not at all...
Do you want to learn to fry tempura,
Lady Haruhime?
theater_san_quest_02_01_10:
Yes! The seafood tempura you made for us
that one time was exquisite, Lady Mikoto.
theater_san_quest_02_01_11:
I want to make everyone happy
with food like that too!
theater_san_quest_02_01_12:
...I see.
In that case, I shall help.
theater_san_quest_02_01_13: I'll teach you everything I can.
theater_san_quest_02_01_14:
R-really?!
U-um... But all the ingredients are
burned to a crisp...
theater_san_quest_02_01_15:
Then first, we gather ingredients.
No time like the present. Let's go shopping.
theater_san_quest_02_01_16:
L-Lady Mikoto?! Thank you!
I'm so sorry. I'm always causing you trouble...
theater_san_quest_02_01_17:
It's quite all right. If I can be of help
to you, it's my greatest wish—
theater_san_quest_02_01_18:
—By the way... When making tempura,
there are ingredients that are kind
to beginners.
theater_san_quest_02_01_20:
There's a grain from the Dungeon called
Dungeon Grain. It makes a wonderfully
fluffy batter.
theater_san_quest_02_01_22:
It also holds up well to heat and doesn't
burn easily, so it's perfect for beginners.
theater_san_quest_02_01_23:
Though...since it comes from the Dungeon,
it's not always in stock, sadly...
theater_san_quest_02_02_02:
Yes. She's been eager to make tempura,
so I'm helping out.
theater_san_quest_02_02_03:
Lady Mikoto told me about Dungeon Grain,
which doesn't burn easily...
theater_san_quest_02_02_06:
Paying top valis at the market? You're
adventurers. Why not go and get it yourselves?
theater_san_quest_02_02_07:
Th-that's... If we gathered it in the Dungeon,
I'd only hold everyone back, and besides,
it's nearly time for supper...
theater_san_quest_02_02_10:
This girl doesn't know the first thing about
trial and error. If you want to learn something,
you start by working it out yourself.
theater_san_quest_02_02_11:
If you skip that and lend a hand,
she won't learn a thing, will she?
theater_san_quest_02_02_12:
Urk...
B-but Lady Haruhime has already tried...
theater_san_quest_02_02_13: The tempura...came out burnt black, but...
theater_san_quest_02_02_17:
I believe that Lady Haruhime isn't the type
to lean on a little help and stop moving
forward.
theater_san_quest_02_02_18:
No... It's more accurate to say I became
sure of it seeing her choose to defy fate.
theater_san_quest_02_02_20:
...Still, teaching this clumsy, hopeless fox
to cook is no small task, you know.
theater_san_quest_02_02_21:
I...am well aware of that.
Countless ingredients will be burned to a crisp.
theater_san_quest_02_02_22:
Spilled oil, small fires...
Unforeseen problems may arise.
theater_san_quest_02_02_23:
But even so, I want to help Lady Haruhime...
I'll take on this challenge ready to
lay down my life!
theater_san_quest_02_02_25:
...Honestly.
You're a hopeless straight arrow, you know that?
theater_san_quest_02_02_27:
Don't take every little bit of nagging
so seriously... Honestly.
theater_san_quest_02_02_28:
Um! Once I've mastered it, I'll make some for you
too, Lady Aisha! Tempura is ever so delicious!
theater_san_quest_02_02_29:
I won't hold my breath.
Go on and practice with your self-appointed
guardian there.
theater_san_quest_02_03_01:
Ohh, we got everything else,
but there's no Dungeon Grain, it seems...
theater_san_quest_02_03_02:
It's a rare, high-end ingredient,
so I suppose it can't be helped...
theater_san_quest_02_03_03:
It's nearly dinnertime.
Shall we give up and head home?
theater_san_quest_02_03_05:
...Even without the ideal ingredients, the joy
of cooking lies in making the most of what
you have.
theater_san_quest_02_03_06:
As cooks, let's look on the bright side
and call it a good challenge.
theater_san_quest_02_03_07:
You're right! Building experience one step
at a time, someday I'll make crispy, fluffy
tempura like yours, Lady Mikoto—
theater_san_quest_02_03_08:
Ah, Haruhime!
Perfect timing. There's a delivery for you...
theater_san_quest_02_03_09:
A delivery...?
That box over there?
theater_san_quest_02_03_10:
Yeah. There's fresh stuff in it,
so they said to give it to you quickly...
theater_san_quest_02_03_13:
All perfect for tempura! And this plant is...
Dungeon Grain?!
theater_san_quest_02_03_15: Yeah, Aisha stopped by a little while ago—
theater_san_quest_02_03_16:
She said she picked it up on the side during
a quest, so hurry up and turn it into tempura
or whatever...
theater_san_quest_02_03_17:
And the shrimp and fish are a bonus,
she said to tell you.
theater_san_quest_02_03_18:
Judging by the time... She must have gone
into the Dungeon right after we parted...?
theater_san_quest_02_03_21:
Ah, my apologies...
It's just, talk about coddling... I couldn't
help laughing...
theater_san_quest_02_03_22:
For all she said, she cares about
Lady Haruhime more deeply than anyone...
theater_san_quest_02_03_24:
Hee-hee... That's right. Lady Aisha always
helps me, even while giving me a hard time...
theater_san_quest_02_03_25: She truly is someone to be grateful for.
theater_san_quest_02_03_26:
...Yes, I am truly blessed.
So that I don't betray both your kindness
with tonight's dinner—
theater_san_quest_02_03_27:
I'll make the very best tempura!
Lady Mikoto, please don't hold back
with your instruction!
theater_san_quest_03_01_01:
The laundry's all done...
Next, I'll clean the hallway...
theater_san_quest_03_01_03:
Oh, Lady Mikoto?
Is something the matter?
theater_san_quest_03_01_04:
YOU'RE the one something's the matter with!
Why are you doing chores dressed like THAT?!
theater_san_quest_03_01_05:
Don't tell me... The heat wave has dulled your
wits, or your instincts snapped and your sense
of freedom broke all limits?!
theater_san_quest_03_01_06:
Kon?! Y-you go too far, Lady Mikoto!
Um, there's a reason for this—
theater_san_quest_03_01_07:
Huh?
You never get a chance to wear your swimsuit?
theater_san_quest_03_01_08:
Y-yes... I bought it on a whim, but I never get
to go near the water, so it's just sitting
unused...
theater_san_quest_03_01_09:
What are you on about?
If you want to wear it, just wear it.
theater_san_quest_03_01_11:
If you bought it to look at, fine. If not,
wearing it solves everything, doesn't it?
theater_san_quest_03_01_12:
That's true, but...
wearing a swimsuit around our home...
theater_san_quest_03_01_13:
At home, no strangers are gonna see you.
What's the problem?
theater_san_quest_03_01_15:
Aren't you being tricked?!
No... Isn't she toying with you?!
theater_san_quest_03_01_16:
So it IS strange... Lady Aisha always wears
that see-through outfit, so I thought
at least at home...
theater_san_quest_03_01_17:
Please don't measure yourself by the see-through,
skin-baring standards of the Amazons!
There are men living here, you know!
theater_san_quest_03_01_18: Ah... Now that you mention it!
theater_san_quest_03_01_20:
It's true... Master Bell and Sir Welf
live here too...
theater_san_quest_03_01_21:
What if...what if they saw me dressed like this
as a provocation, and it ignited the flames
of their lust...
theater_san_quest_03_01_22:
W-well... They're all gentlemen,
so I doubt it would go that far...
theater_san_quest_03_01_23:
Ahh! What if my careless behavior misleads them,
and they lose control to their animal instincts!
theater_san_quest_03_01_25: If that happened, I... I would...!
theater_san_quest_03_02_05:
An invitation... It IS, isn't it?! For my
red-hot hammer! To stoke a blazing
crimson flame!!
theater_san_quest_03_02_07: Sir Welf is not that kind of man!
theater_san_quest_03_02_08:
Ah... At least, at least, I beg you...
let my first time be with HIM...!
theater_san_quest_03_02_10:
Ah...! But even he...
seeing me dressed so shamelessly...
theater_san_quest_03_02_13:
Haruhimeeee... I can't hold back
any longeeeer...
theater_san_quest_03_02_14:
Wh-what's come over you...?
This isn't the Master Bell I know...!
theater_san_quest_03_02_15:
Guh-heh-heh... It's your fault for dressing
like thaaat... Guh-heh-heh-heeeh!
theater_san_quest_03_02_17: No such Sir Bell exists in this world!
theater_san_quest_03_02_18:
Huh... What? Lady...Mikoto...?
I-I was just being chased by a
guh-heh-hehing Master Bell...
theater_san_quest_03_02_19:
Please come to your senses!
There's no one here but you and me!
theater_san_quest_03_02_20:
In any case, before things truly get worse,
let's change back into your usual kimono!
theater_san_quest_03_03_01:
Ah, Sir Bell, Sir Welf!
It's nothing! We'll be going right away—!
theater_san_quest_03_03_02:
—Wait, huh?!
Haruhime, what are you wearing...?!
theater_san_quest_03_03_03:
Ahh! Please don't look...!
Not at me like this...!
theater_san_quest_03_03_04:
Please don't look upon this sinful swimsuit
that stirs men to beastly deeds—
theater_san_quest_03_03_08:
What do you think you're wearing
in the home of a virgin goddess?!
theater_san_quest_03_03_09:
Th-that's not it, Lady Hestia...!
Lady Haruhime was just about to change...
theater_san_quest_03_03_10:
You were obviously trying to seduce Bell and
the others! "Stirs men to beastly deeds"?!
theater_san_quest_03_03_11:
S-seduce? I'd never presume...
I was only worried I might turn men
into beasts...!
theater_san_quest_03_03_12:
That I might pour oil on Sir Welf's raging
flames, or awaken Master Bell's heroic
appetite for women—
theater_san_quest_03_03_15:
Come on! Get it off already!
I won't let you seduce Bell!!
theater_san_quest_03_03_17:
...Bell, let's go.
If we stay here, we'll get dragged into this.
theater_san_quest_03_03_20:
Lady Hestia! Lady Haruhime is going to
have a wardrobe malfunction!!
theater_san_quest_09_01_01:
So this is an Orario ball!
Everyone's dressed in such dazzling gowns—
theater_san_quest_09_01_02: It's like stepping into a tale of knights!
theater_san_quest_09_01_03:
Yeah... In fairy tales, this is where
the hero meets the princess.
theater_san_quest_09_01_04:
Yes! And they fall in love and share
a dizzying romance... Ah... Maybe I, like

theater_san_quest_09_01_05:
My princess, my sweet! Haruhimeeeee?
Let's slip away from the ball and share
a dizzying romance of our own—
theater_san_quest_09_01_06:
Let's enjoy a red-hot "one night's dream"!
Come, there's nothing to fear!
Come to me, Haruhimeee!
theater_san_quest_09_01_07:
Oh, myyy! M...Master Bell!
You mustn't! No! It's not that I don't
want to, but—
theater_san_quest_09_01_08:
Ah... Um... Well...
I need to prepare myself...
theater_san_quest_09_01_10:
...The perverted fox daydreaming again?
Quit dithering and just jump him
in his sleep already.
theater_san_quest_09_01_14:
I'm surprised, Lady Aisha.
That you'd come to a place like this...
theater_san_quest_09_01_15:
I just smelled it, y'know.
Felt like there'd be some good men here.
theater_san_quest_09_01_17:
Followed my gut, and look—loads of men
with a style you don't usually see.
theater_san_quest_09_01_18:
Little Rookie,
you clean up pretty nice yourself.
theater_san_quest_09_01_20:
Clothes make the man. Even a rabbit in a
tailcoat. This look of yours...is pretty
tempting.
theater_san_quest_09_01_21:
I dunno... It makes me want to mess up that
neat, proper outfit and make you mine.
Heh, maybe just gobble you up...
theater_san_quest_09_01_23: (L-Lady Aisha has the eyes of a predator?!)
theater_san_quest_09_01_24:
M...Master Bell! I have something important to
discuss with Lady Aisha! Could you please
leave us alone for a little while?!
